 I live in North Carolina where Roy Cooper was just elected to the U.S. Senate. I sent him an email urging him to support an increase in the federal minimum wage. If you are in North Carolina, I invite you to send him a similar message. Online I found his contact information is info@roycooper.com 
 If you live somewhere else and have a Democratic Senator, I invite you to send them an email.
 If you only have Republican Senators, I invite you to revise the letter and urge them to support an increase in the federal minimum wage.
 So, here’s the message I sent to Cooper:
 Dear Senator Cooper,
 I am writing to encourage you to support an increase in the federal minimum wage. As you know, the federal minimum wage has remained at $7.25 per hour since 2009. If the minimum wage had kept pace with inflation and increases in worker productivity, the minimum wage would be around $23 or $24 per hour today.
 Now that the Democrats will control both chambers of Congress starting in January 2027, it is high time to increase the minimum wage to show that the Democrats are actually doing something to help American workers and American families.
 According to the Pew Research Center, FIVE YEARS ago a majority of Americans (62%) supported raising the federal minimum wage to $15. Surely Americans would support an even higher minimum wage today.
 Sincerely,
 We'll get straight to the point: The financial hardships that Daily Kos is facing this year are tough.
 We continue to be paywall-free. We continue to be supported by our readers, not billionaires or corporations. But we need to bring in more revenue. We are leaning on our community more than ever to help make ends meet. Can you donate $5 or more to support Daily Kos and our continued work?
